title: Ranking with tie-breakers
prompt: Implement `static List<string> Rank(List<(string Name, int Score)> rows)` — names ordered by score descending, ties broken by name ascending; and `static (string Name, int Score)? Top(List<(string Name, int Score)> rows)` — the first-ranked row or null for an empty/null list.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: OrderByDescending(score).ThenBy(name) is the whole ranking algorithm.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Nullable return type makes "no row" explicit instead of a crash.
